    all_threads=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp = api_fn(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, access_token=token)
        # resp expected list
        if not resp:
            break
        all_threads.extend(resp)
        # safety break if API returns fewer than page_limit
        if len(resp) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_threads

def fetch_all_threads(api_fn, query, page_limit=20):

print('Inbox threads:', len(inbox_threads))
print('Archived threads:', len(arch_threads))
print('Spam threads:', len(spam_threads))

# prefilter by keyword in subject or preview

def prefilter(thread_list):
    out=[]
    for t in thread_list:
        subj = (t.get('subject') or '').lower()
        prev = (t.get('preview') or '').lower()
        if any(k in subj or k in prev for k in keywords):
            out.append(t)
    return out

]

    # Promo Code => AMZxxxx
    r'(?i)\bpromo\s*code\b\s*[^A-Za-z0-9]*?(?:=>|=|:|-|\u2013|\u2014)?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]{3,24})',
    # Use code AMZxxxx
    r'(?i)\buse\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:promo\s+)?code\b\s*[^A-Za-z0-9]*?(?:=>|=|:|-|\u2013|\u2014)?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]{3,24})',
    # Enter code AMZxxxx
    r'(?i)\benter\s+code\b\s*[^A-Za-z0-9]*?(?:=>|=|:|-|\u2013|\u2014)?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]{3,24})',
    # Your code is AMZxxxx
    r'(?i)\byour\s+code\s+is\b\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]{3,24})',
    # Discount Code => AMZxxxx
    r'(?i)\b(?:discount|coupon)\s*code\b\s*[^A-Za-z0-9]*?(?:=>|=|:|-|\u2013|\u2014)?\s*([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]{3,24})',
]

compiled = [re.compile(p) for p in promo_patterns]

def extract_codes(text):
    if not text:
        return []
    s=str(text)
    found=[]
    for creg in compiled:
        for m in creg.finditer(s):
            found.append(m.group(1))
    # normalize and filter
    filtered=[]
    for c in found:
        if not c:
            continue
        c=c.strip()
        # length & composition checks
        if len(c) < 4 or len(c) > 24:
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r'\d+', c):
            continue
        if not (re.search(r'[A-Za-z]', c) and re.search(r'\d', c)):
            continue
        # avoid extremely short patterns
        filtered.append(c)
    # dedup preserve order
    return list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(filtered))
